positions.title: Simulation Engineer
positions.description:
• Develop, maintain and support Hardware in the loop platform
• Develop simulation models using Matlab/Simulink
• Construct full-coverage automatic test sequences for validating Vehicle control unit functions

positions.title: Course Assistant
positions.description: Introduction to Scientific Computating: Prepared course material (Matlab live script for lectures and homework) assisted in-class hands-on practices and lead office hours to assist students.

positions.title: Software Verification Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Performed in-depth root-cause analysis on vehicle testing data to identify critical software failure events, preventing vehicle collisions and improving autonomous driving software.
• Resolved incompatibility issues between software modules for continuous integration of image builds daily, enabling smooth collaboration and ensuring all new features are pushed and tested.
• Constructed simulation test cases that tested autonomous driving system's behavior under otherwise hard-to-generate real-world cases and provide insights to developers.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
• Digitalized routine documents and databases with VBA, enabling fast processing and communication, automated tasks previously done manually.
• Developed patient care  fiscal and operational system, raising DAPT adherence rate and lowering risks for heart surgery patients.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:

• Created an online component management system, lowering budgets and tracking component flow.

projects.title: Music Sharing Chatroom
projects.description:
• Created an interactive Django web application where users can share playlists and listen to music in sync across different locations
• Developed with Spotify and Geolocation API
• Implemented user interaction features including bullet live commenting, song recommendation systems and chatroom membership managements using web sockets
• Deployed and fully functional on AWS EC2, integrating HTML5, CSS, Bootstrap, Ajax, jQuery and Postgres
